entities.summary: Alek Isaac Manoah is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Los Angeles Angels of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Toronto Blue Jays. The Blue Jays selected Manoah with the 11th overall pick of the 2019 MLB draft out of West Virginia University. He made his MLB debut in 2021 and was an All-Star in 2022.
